notablePrerequisites:
Najeela does not have summoning sickness.
Mirage Phalanx is paired with Composite Golem.
Opponents can not block and kill Najeela.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Composte Golem and Mirage Phalanx trigger, creating copies of themselves with haste and without soulbond.
Attack with Najeela.
Najeela triggers, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Activate the Composite Golem token by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures you control, giving them haste, trample and lifelink and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Pass to the next combat phase.
Repeat.
